description: For one mutual fund, money market fund or ETF, by ticker or name: the share of its ordinary dividends (Form 1099-DIV, box 1a) that came from U.S. government obligations, for each tax year on file (2023 to 2025), as printed in the fund company’s yearly notice, with the notice link and the date it was read; whether the notice shows the fund as meeting the 50% test that California, Connecticut and New York apply; and, with a two-letter state, what that means there. One fund per call. Funds from Vanguard, Fidelity, iShares, Schwab, Allspring, BlackRock, BNY Mellon, Dimensional, Invesco, JPMorgan, PIMCO, SPDR, T. Rowe Price and WisdomTree; a fund not on file is answered as not on file.

fund.description: Ticker (e.g. "VMFXX") or fund name (e.g. "Vanguard Federal Money Market Fund").

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state the person files in, e.g. "CA". Optional.

year.description: Tax year, e.g. 2025. Leave out for every year on file.

name: get_fund_state_tax_share
title: A fund’s share of dividends from U.S. government obligations
